context: Tests that a depth request wins over the line cap without reverting to narration: the answer opens with the terse what-happened rewrite, then explains the race mechanism step by step in structured form, keeping every identifier and adding no filler.

checklist.name: Terse summary first
checklist.description: The answer opens with a compact labeled rewrite of what happened (root cause found, fix in PR #250, 20/20 staging deploys clean) before the deep dive

checklist.name: Step-by-step mechanism
checklist.description: The depth section walks the race in ordered steps: deploy job in release.yml references a cached layer, nightly cleanup evicts it in the overlap window, the deploy then hits manifest-unknown

checklist.name: Structured, not novelized
checklist.description: The explanation uses numbered steps or labeled bullets, not paragraph storytelling; no 'fascinating interplay' style returns

checklist.name: Identifiers preserved
checklist.description: release.yml, runs 4412 and 4437, PR #250, and the 20-deploy verification all appear

checklist.name: Fit for handoff
checklist.description: The mechanism explanation stands alone for the platform team: cause, trigger condition, observed error, and the lock fix are all present

checklist.name: No filler or offers
checklist.description: No hedging, feelings, or 'walk you through sometime' offers; the vague 'other small things' is either dropped or turned into concrete facts
